---
name: Feature request
about: You want Signalman to do something it doesn't do today.
title: "[feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
---

## What you're trying to do

Describe the use case in your own words. The more concrete, the
better — `I'm trying to ...` beats `it would be nice if ...`. If you
have a real workflow that's blocked by Signalman not doing this, lead
with that workflow.

## What you've tried

Existing Signalman features you've used or considered. If you got
partway with the current surface, describe how far and where it
broke down.

## Proposed shape

If you have an idea for how the feature should look (a CLI verb, an
MCP tool, a config option, a build-yaml field, etc.), describe it
here. Optional — it's also fine to leave the design open and let the
discussion shape it.

## Alternatives

Other ways the same problem could be solved. Often the right answer
is "no new feature, document the existing path better" or "add an
example scenario." Mention what you considered and rejected, and why.

## Anything else

Links to related issues, prior discussions, code references, or
external projects that handle this well.
